svg.text: UML Sequence Diagram: Group 7 – System Administration
Actor: Administrator | Flow A: Accounts | Flow B: Course Permissions | Flow C: Speech Configuration
[Invalid Input: duplicate email or weak password]
[Flow B: Lecturer and Subject Permission Management]
[Flow C: STT and TTS Language and Voice Configuration]
[Admin Action: Toggle Account Status: Disable or Enable]
Render account list and management actions
8. Insert User: hashedPassword, role, Status Active
18. click Assign or Revoke Teaching Access
21. Check Lecturer role and Course exists
Update course assignment table in UI
CurrentSettings: language vi-VN, voice Kore, provider Gemini
26. selectLanguageAndVoice: language vi-VN or en-US, voice Kore
Throw 400 Bad Request: Unsupported language or voice
Display success banner: Note that NO external STT or TTS call is made
